protocol.event: Calendar year station TNn <= threshold, not crop-loss event.
protocol.residualDistribution: Training station-year TNn(station) minus matched TNn(ERA5EX), with each station equal total mass; 17 equally weighted inverse-CDF midpoint quantiles. Convolve source ERA5 annual distribution with residual distribution.
protocol.localCorrection: Station residual mean, Gaussian geographic distance scales 100/250/500km, Gaussian native CHELSA BIO06 difference scale3C, no neighbours beyond500km. Weight-sum support shrinkage: correction=weightedMeanBias*(1-exp(-sumWeights)); no neighbour implies zero correction.
cv: Leave-one-geographic-region-out, raw fallback when no local neighbour.
Leave100kmstationclusterout: for each held station exclude all training stations within100km, preventing immediate neighbouring sources.
protocol.metrics: Station-balanced annual-event Brier score and absolute observed-versus-predicted annual freeze-frequency error; source probabilities use only exact matched accepted years to avoid differing observation windows.
caveats: Error convolution describes thermometer-scale uncertainty and does not correct freeze timing/duration, cold pools or yield response.
Model choice from these CV comparisons requires external validation; scores are not independently confirmed future skill.
Few training stations in some regions and no adequate Japan/Chile/North Africa stations.
